The '''Flower House''' is a [[Location]] on the outskirts of the {{Zone|Village}} on the [[Hub Island]]. It serves as home to {{NPCSprite|Marco}} and an automatically regrowing field of [[Flowers]].

{{ZoneText|Talk to Marco about &aSpray Cans&f.|Gather flowers.}}

== Purpose ==
The '''Flower House''' is home to {{NPCSprite|Marco}}, who first tasks the player to bring back 5 {{Item|Rose Red}} dyes. These can be collected by harvesting {{Item|Poppy|text=Poppies}} in the [[Flowers|flower]] field outside the house. Upon providing these items, '''Marco''' will provide a {{Item|Spray Can}}.
